meta.name: fathom
meta.description: Fetch meetings, transcripts, summaries, and action items from Fathom API. Use when user asks to get Fathom recordings, sync meeting transcripts, or fetch recent calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取会议记录、转录和行动项
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从Fathom获取会议数据并同步到工作流
copy.tagline_en: Fetch meeting recordings, transcripts, and action items
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to retrieve meeting data from Fathom and sync it into your workflow

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以获取你在 Fathom 中的会议记录，包括文字稿、AI 摘要、待办事项和参与者信息，并保存为 Markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求查看 Fathom 会议记录、同步会议文字稿或获取近期通话时触发。

say.text: 帮我列出最近的 Fathom 会议。
say.note: Claude 会调用 --list 命令显示最近会议列表。

say.text: 获取今天的所有 Fathom 会议记录。
say.note: Claude 会调用 --today 命令获取今日会议。

say.text: 获取 Fathom 会议 ID 为 abc123 的详情。
say.note: Claude 会调用 --id 命令获取指定会议。

howto.what_en: Claude can fetch meeting data from Fathom API, including transcripts, AI summaries, action items, and participant info, saving them as Markdown files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to view Fathom recordings, sync meeting transcripts, or fetch recent calls.

say_en.note: Claude runs --list to show recent meetings.

say_en.text: Fetch all Fathom meetings from today.
say_en.note: Claude runs --today to get today's meetings.

say_en.text: Get details for Fathom meeting ID abc123.
say_en.note: Claude runs --id to fetch that meeting.
